subject: Single tree with tips on the left

messages.author: e24192e2756334f2
messages.subject: Single tree with tips on the left
parts:
Is it possible using ggtree to plot a tree with the tips on the left?  I've searched and searched but the only example I've seen is where two trees are plotted face to face. It's not clear to me how you would just plot one tree this way. In ape, plot.phylo has the direction="leftwards" option.  Can this be done in ggtree?


Thanks!

mh
